description.zh: 播流所属应用名称。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看AppName。
description.en: The name of the application to which the stream belongs. You can view AppName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

description.zh:
推流域名或主播流域名。
> - 传入DomainName时，请保证传入域名为直播域名，同时调用本接口的用户拥有传入域名的操作权限。
description.en:
The ingest domain or streamer streaming domain.
> - When you specify DomainName, make sure that the domain name is a live streaming domain name and that the user calling this operation has the permissions to operate on the specified domain name.

description.zh: 结束时间。EndTime和StartTime之间的间隔不能超过30天。 格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The end time. The interval between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 30 days. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC).

description.zh:
排序方式。取值：

- **stream_name_desc**：按直播流名称倒序。
- **stream_name_asc**：按直播流名称升序。
- **publish_time_desc**：按推流时间倒序。
- **publish_time_asc**（默认值）：按推流时间升序。
description.en:
The sorting method. Valid values:

- **stream_name_desc**: sorts by live stream name in descending order.
- **stream_name_asc**: sorts by live stream name in ascending order.
- **publish_time_desc**: sorts by stream ingest time in descending order.
- **publish_time_asc** (default): sorts by stream ingest time in ascending order.
The page size. Valid values: **1 to 3000**. Default value: **2000**.

description.zh:
指定是否模糊匹配流名称。取值：
- **fuzzy**（默认值）：模糊匹配。
- **strict**：精准匹配。
description.en:
Specifies whether to use fuzzy match for the stream name. Valid values:
- **fuzzy** (default): fuzzy match.
- **strict**: exact match.
The start time of stream ingest. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC).

description.zh: 播流名称。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看StreamName。
description.en: The stream name. You can view StreamName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

description.zh:
流类型。取值：

- **不传**：查询原始流。
- **all**：查询所有流。
- **trans**：查询转码流。
description.en:
The stream type. Valid values:

- **Not specified**: queries raw streams.
- **all**: queries all streams.
- **trans**: queries transcoded streams.

title.en: Query historical stream list for a domain name

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口最多可查询近30天的历史流。返回的数据为查询时间段内的在线流信息。本接口目前支持以下排序方式：

- stream_name_desc：按直播流名称倒序。

- stream_name_asc：按直播流名称升序。

- publish_time_desc：按推流时间倒序。

- publish_time_asc：按推流时间升序。



## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为3次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to query historical streams within the last 30 days. The returned data contains the active stream information within the specified time range. This operation supports the following sorting methods:

- stream_name_desc: sorts by live stream name in descending order.

- stream_name_asc: sorts by live stream name in ascending order.

- publish_time_desc: sorts by stream ingest time in descending order.

- publish_time_asc: sorts by stream ingest time in ascending order.



## QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 3 calls per second. If this limit is exceeded, the API call is throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation appropriately.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-streams-publish-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --page-size 1500 --page-number 1 --stream-type all --query-type fuzzy --order-by publish_time_desc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveStreamsPublishList --region cn-hangzhou --OrderBy publish_time_desc --StreamType all --StreamName liveStream0000 --EndTime '2017-12-22T08:00:00Z' --PageSize 1500 --DomainName 'example.com' --PageNumber 1 --StartTime '2017-12-21T08:00:00Z' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --QueryType fuzzy --AppName liveApp0000
